drafts.target_section: Forged documents and impersonation > What happens
drafts.claim: According to a case the US embassy in Dhaka filed against five Bangladeshis, reported in a Prothom Alo editorial of 25 February 2024, two Bangladeshis named Mofizur Rahman and Ashraful Alam Bhuiyan admitted at their US visa interview on 11 February that they were involved in trafficking people from Bangladesh to various countries, and they had submitted fake documents to the embassy.
quotes: মামলার অভিযোগে বলা হয়, ১১ ফেব্রুয়ারি
যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে যাওয়ার জন্য তাঁরা দূতাবাসে ভুয়া নথিও জমা দিয়েছিলেন
drafts.why_new: An embassy itself filing a case over fake documents and an admission made at the visa interview; the section has no embassy-filed case.

drafts.target_section: Departure day at the airport > Documented cases
drafts.claim: According to the same US embassy case (editorial of 25 February 2024), one of the two men admitted that an immigration officer at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka helped him in exchange for money.
quotes: উল্লিখিত দুজনের একজন স্বীকার করেছেন, তাঁকে অর্থের বিনিময়ে শাহজালাল আন্তর্জাতিক বিমানবন্দরে একজন অভিবাসন কর্মকর্তা সাহায্য করেন
drafts.why_new: A recorded admission of a paid immigration officer at Dhaka airport helping a trafficker.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: A Daily Star report of 23 February 2024, cited in a Prothom Alo editorial, said BRAC's Migration Programme rescued and brought home 629 people in 2022 who had been living in misery abroad without valid papers, and that they had been taken to Libya with the promise of attractive jobs in Europe.
quotes: ২০২২ সালে এ রকম ৬২৯ জনকে উদ্ধার করে দেশে ফেরত এনেছে ব্র্যাকের অভিবাসন কর্মসূচি
ইউরোপে লোভনীয় চাকরি দেওয়ার নাম করে তাঁদের লিবিয়ায় নিয়ে যাওয়া হয়েছিল
drafts.why_new: A returns figure for BRAC's programme for 2022; the section gives only IOM-assisted returns.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: According to UNHCR, as cited in a Prothom Alo editorial of 25 February 2024, 13 per cent of the 5,236 refugees and migrant workers who went to Italy by sea were Bangladeshi citizens (the editorial does not state the period).
quotes: ইউএনএইচসিআরের মতে, সমুদ্রপথে ইতালি যাওয়া ৫ হাজার ২৩৬ জন শরণার্থী ও অভিবাসী কর্মীর ১৩ শতাংশই বাংলাদেশের নাগরিক
drafts.why_new: An early-2024 share figure; the period is not printed, so it needs a check against UNHCR before use.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: On 15 February 2024 a boat carrying 52 migrants caught fire and sank in the Mediterranean off the Tunisian coast; 8 Bangladeshis died, 26 others were rescued and one was seriously injured, according to a Prothom Alo editorial of 25 February 2024.
quotes: ১৫ ফেব্রুয়ারি তিউনিসিয়া উপকূলে
অপর ২৬ জনকে উদ্ধার করা হয়েছে
drafts.why_new: The February 2024 Tunisia boat deaths are not in the Death list.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The path
drafts.claim: The police Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime unit identified a Libya-based trafficker who had appointed 40 brokers across Bangladesh whose job was to find young people wanting to go abroad, according to a Prothom Alo editorial of 25 February 2024.
quotes: কাউন্টার টেররিজম অ্যান্ড ট্রান্সন্যাশনাল ক্রাইম লিবিয়াভিত্তিক এক পাচারকারীকে শনাক্ত করে বলেছে, ওই ব্যক্তি সারা দেশে ৪০ জন দালাল নিয়োগ করেছেন, যাদের কাজ হলো বিদেশে গমনে ইচ্ছুক তরুণদের খুঁজে বের করা
drafts.why_new: Shows the scale of one Libya-based trafficker's recruiting network in Bangladesh (40 brokers).

drafts.target_section: The law in Bangladesh
drafts.claim: A Home Ministry report on trafficking said that in January to September 2023, courts disposed of 332 cases under the trafficking Act; in 316 of them (95.18 per cent) all the accused were acquitted, and in the other 16 cases 56 people were punished, only two of them with life imprisonment, according to a Prothom Alo editorial of 25 February 2024.
quotes: জানুয়ারি থেকে সেপ্টেম্বর
এর মধ্যে ৩১৬ মামলায়
drafts.why_new: The guide states penalties but not how trafficking cases actually end; this is the acquittal rate.

drafts.target_section: The law in Bangladesh
drafts.claim: The father of a woman from Savar said the people he had sued for trafficking his daughter to India on the promise of taking her to Canada were all released, and that he himself spent four months in jail in a case the defendants filed against him, according to a Prothom Alo editorial of 25 February 2024.
quotes: সাভারের এক ভুক্তভোগী নারীর বাবা জানান
উল্টো বিবাদীদের করা মামলায় তাঁকে চার মাস জেল খাটতে হয়েছে
drafts.why_new: A complainant jailed in a counter-case after the accused were acquitted; the guide has no counter-case example.

drafts.target_section: The law in Bangladesh
drafts.claim: Salma Ali, president of the Bangladesh National Women Lawyers' Association, said trafficking cases are not investigated properly because ring members are very influential, and that they threaten victims into out-of-court settlements, as quoted in a Prothom Alo editorial of 25 February 2024.
quotes: বাংলাদেশ জাতীয় মহিলা আইনজীবী সমিতির সভাপতি সালমা আলী
drafts.why_new: A named expert's explanation of why cases fail: influence, and threats that force compromise.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: According to relatives, police and local sources, several young men from Rajoir, Madaripur, and Muksudpur, Gopalganj, left home for Italy on 14 January 2024, flew through Dubai to Libya, and on 14 February left Libya on an engine boat through brokers; eight of them died on the boat in the Mediterranean off Tunisia (five from Rajoir and three from Muksudpur), along with one Pakistani.
quotes: গত ১৪ জানুয়ারি মাদারীপুরের রাজৈর
পরে ১৪ ফেব্রুয়ারি লিবিয়া থেকে
আটজনের মধ্যে পাঁচজনই মাদারীপুরের রাজৈরের বাসিন্দা। বাকি তিনজনের বাড়ি গোপালগঞ্জের মুকসুদপুরে
drafts.why_new: Home districts, dates and route of the February 2024 Tunisia boat deaths.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Relatives of the eight dead told journalists at Dhaka airport on 2 May 2024 that brokers had put 52 people on a small boat that could take 30, that the eight who died had been forced to stay below the deck, and that when they tried to come out for lack of oxygen the brokers beat them and sent them back down; the relatives said they died of the torture and lack of oxygen.
quotes: ৩০ জন যেতে পারবেন
যে আটজন মারা গেছেন, তাঁদের নৌকার পাটাতনের নিচে জোর করে রাখা হয়েছিল। তাঁরা অক্সিজেন-সংকটের কারণে পাটাতন থেকে বেরিয়ে আসার চেষ্টা করেন। কিন্তু দালালেরা তাঁদের মারধর করে আবার সেখানে পাঠান
drafts.why_new: How people die on these boats without the boat sinking: overloading and being held below deck.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: The brother of Sajal Bairagi (22) of Sendia village, Rajoir, Madaripur, one of the eight who died on the boat off Tunisia in February 2024, told Prothom Alo the family gave BDT 14 lakh to a broker named Mosharraf by selling land and cows and borrowing.
quotes: জমি, গরু বিক্রি করে
drafts.why_new: A 2024 price and how it was raised (land, cattle, loans).

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: Sajal Bairagi's brother said in May 2024 that the broker was telling the family not to file a case and had said he would return some money but was not giving it, and that, being poor and unable to afford a case, the family was trying to settle with the broker.
quotes: এখন দালাল মামলা করতে না করছেন। কিছু টাকা ফেরত দেবেন বলে বলেছেন, কিন্তু দিচ্ছেন না
তাই দালালের সঙ্গে আপস করার চেষ্টা করছেন
drafts.why_new: Shows why no case follows a death: the broker discourages it with a refund promise and the family cannot afford one.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: The Madaripur Superintendent of Police, Masud Alam, told Prothom Alo in May 2024 that police would give all legal help if relatives of the eight dead filed a case, but that the victims had little interest in filing cases.
quotes: মাদারীপুরের পুলিশ সুপার মাসুদ আলম প্রথম আলোকে বলেন, এ ঘটনায় নিহত ব্যক্তিদের স্বজনেরা মামলা করলে সব ধরনের আইনি সহযোগিতা করা হবে
তবে ভুক্তভোগীরা মামলা করতে আগ্রহী কম
drafts.why_new: Police position: they act only if the family files, and families mostly do not.

drafts.target_section: How is the body brought home?
drafts.claim: The bodies of the eight Bangladeshis who died on a boat off Tunisia in February 2024 reached Dhaka's Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport on a Saudia flight on 2 May 2024, and were sent to the Dhaka Medical College morgue for post-mortem before being handed to the families.
quotes: সৌদিয়া এয়ারলাইনসের একটি ফ্লাইটে
কিন্তু ময়নাতদন্তের জন্য
drafts.why_new: The bodies came home about two and a half months after the deaths, and went to a post-mortem before release to families.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > How it is sold
drafts.claim: Azmir Hossain (24) of Mirsarai, Chattogram, said a Libya-based Bangladeshi from his own area, Shahadat Hossain, kept tempting his mother with a job in Italy paying BDT 50,000 a month, took BDT 1.5 lakh in advance, and had Azmir carry the rest of the money with him.
quotes: লিবিয়াপ্রবাসী শাহাদাত হোসেন ৫০ হাজার টাকা বেতনের
এ জন্য আগাম দেড় লাখ টাকাও
drafts.why_new: The seller is a neighbour living in Libya who pitches the mother, names a salary and takes a small advance.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The path
drafts.claim: Azmir Hossain said he reached Dubai on 21 March 2024, where the broker's men met him at the airport and kept 30 to 35 people together in a room of a small house for two days, then flew them to Egypt, held them 24 hours in a warehouse-like place in the airport area, and put them on another plane to Libya.
quotes: গত ২১ মার্চ দুবাই পৌঁছান আজমির। বিমানবন্দরে সাহাদাতের লোকজন তাঁকে রিসিভ করে গাড়িতে তুলে ছোট একটা বাড়ির কক্ষে ৩০-৩৫ জনকে একসঙ্গে রাখেন
সেখানে দুই দিন রেখে
drafts.why_new: Stop-by-stop detail of the Dubai and Egypt legs: who meets them, how many per room, how long at each.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Azmir Hossain said everyone's passport was taken as soon as they reached Libya, that he was beaten whenever he mentioned the promised job, and that BDT 6 lakh was collected from his family in stages by phone.
quotes: লিবিয়া পৌঁছানোর পরই আমাদের সবার পাসপোর্ট কেড়ে নেওয়া হয়
চাকরি দেওয়ার কথা বললেই চলে মারধর
এদিকে বাড়িতে ফোন করে
drafts.why_new: A survivor's first-person account of what follows arrival.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Azmir Hossain said that after collecting BDT 6 lakh from his family the broker sold him to another group at a high price and left him in a Libyan desert to be handed over; he said he escaped with a Libyan citizen's help and took shelter with a Bangladeshi he knew, and that the broker then came and took him back.
quotes: বাড়ি থেকে ছয় লাখ টাকা আদায়ের পর
এক দিন পর সেই পক্ষের হাতে তুলে দিতে লিবিয়ার একটি মরুভূমিতে ফেলে আসেন আমাকে
সেবার এক লিবীয় নাগরিকের
drafts.why_new: Being sold on after the ransom is paid, by the same Bangladeshi who recruited him.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Azmir Hossain said he was locked in a room and beaten regularly for trying to escape, went eight days without food, and reached home on 5 May 2024, 41 days after leaving, in a critical condition; his mother said he is now mentally ill from blows to the head and that she owes BDT 6 lakh.
quotes: সেখানে আট দিন অনাহারে থাকার পর
বাড়ি থেকে বের হওয়ার ৪১ দিন পর
আমার এখন ছয় লাখ টাকা দেনা
drafts.why_new: The whole trip lasted 41 days and never left Libya; the outcome for the family.

drafts.target_section: Proof that is not proof
drafts.claim: Abdullah Al Zobayer (24) of Mirsarai, Chattogram, told Prothom Alo in June 2024 that he trusted a friend who was the younger brother of a Libya-based broker and a member of the ring, was taken to Libya on the promise of Italy, and that the ring collected BDT 4 lakh from his family.
quotes: সাহাদাতের ছোট ভাই চক্রের সদস্য আজাদ হোসেন আমার বন্ধু
আমার পরিবারের কাছ থেকে চার লাখ টাকা আদায় করেছেন তাঁরা
drafts.why_new: The recruiter was the victim's own friend; the section lists standing and track record but not friendship.

drafts.target_section: Recruited while abroad or just back
drafts.claim: Abdullah Al Zobayer, who returned from captivity in Libya in 2024, said the ring that took him has many members and also targets Bangladeshi expatriates in the Middle East, taking people to Libya with talk of good jobs or passage to Europe and holding them hostage to collect money from their families.
quotes: বাংলাদেশ ছাড়াও মধ্যপ্রাচ্যে থাকা প্রবাসীরা
drafts.why_new: A survivor stating that the ring recruits among expatriates already in the Middle East.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: After returning, Azmir Hossain filed a case in a Chattogram court against six people, including the Libya-based broker and his brother; his lawyer told Prothom Alo in June 2024 that it was a criminal case over cheating and torture in Libya and that the court took cognisance of the complaint and ordered an investigation.
quotes: আজমির হোসেন বাদী হয়ে
বিজ্ঞ আদালত অভিযোগ আমলে নিয়ে
drafts.why_new: A returnee filing directly in court, and what the court did.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > Where to get help
drafts.claim: A union parishad member in Karerhat, Mirsarai, said he phoned the Libya-based broker several times to get Azmir Hossain sent home and saw the marks of beating on Azmir's head and body on a video call.
quotes: আজমিরকে দেশে ফেরাতে আমি ফোনে বেশ কয়েকবার সাহাদাতের সঙ্গে কথা বলেছি
ভিডিও কলে সেখানে মারধরে আজমিরের মাথা ফুলাসহ শরীরের বিভিন্ন স্থানে আঘাতের চিহ্ন দেখেছি
drafts.why_new: An elected local representative negotiating directly with the broker in Libya, and a witness to the injuries.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Prothom Alo reported on 13 July 2024 that at least 24 people from Bhairab and elsewhere in Kishoreganj, Habiganj and Narsingdi went to Libya at about the same time through a broker ring led by Rasel Mia of Bhairab to cross to Italy by sea, that none had reached Italy, and that some were hostages of kidnappers and others were in Libyan jails.
quotes: একই সময়ে দালাল রাসেল চক্রের মাধ্যমে
তাঁদের কেউ এখন অপহরণকারীর
drafts.why_new: A whole batch from one broker stranded; two outcomes, kidnappers or Libyan jail.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: Families in the Bhairab case said in July 2024 that the broker Rasel Mia had taken BDT 24 lakh, BDT 23 lakh and BDT 22 lakh each from different men for Italy; the father of Shafiqul Islam of Shibpur, Narsingdi, said that after taking BDT 23 lakh the broker was now asking BDT 10 lakh more to free his son.
quotes: ইতালি পাঠানোর কথা বলে রাসেল ২৩ লাখ টাকা নিয়েছে
রাসেল মিয়া নামের একজনের হাতে
রাসেল নিয়েছেন
drafts.why_new: 2023-24 prices of BDT 22 to 24 lakh paid up front to a Bhairab broker, then a further demand to free the hostage.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Families of two hostages in the Bhairab case said in July 2024 that large ransoms were being demanded but that they could find no one who could assure them that paying would get the men released.
quotes: কিন্তু টাকা দিলে মুক্তি পাবে
drafts.why_new: Families' own statement that nobody guarantees release after payment.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: According to local people in Bhairab, when the hostages phoned home begging to be freed, the broker Rasel Mia and his ring members hid and cut off contact with the families; the families then went to community leaders for a remedy and got no result.
quotes: এমন বিপদের সময় রাসেল
ভুক্তভোগী পরিবারের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ বিচ্ছিন্ন করে দেন
প্রতিকার পেতে ভুক্তভোগী পরিবারের সদস্যরা সমাজপতিদের দ্বারস্থ হন। কিন্তু ফল পাননি
drafts.why_new: What the local broker does once people are taken hostage, and that village arbitration failed.

drafts.target_section: Proof that is not proof
drafts.claim: Local people in Bhairab, Kishoreganj, said in July 2024 that several broker rings sending people to Italy by sea through Libya had been active there for 10 years and that many people did reach Italy through them; the most active, Rasel Mia's ring, then took several crore taka from 24 people, none of whom reached Italy.
quotes: ভৈরবে ১০ বছর আগে
চক্রগুলোর মাধ্যমে অনেকে ইতালি যেতে পারেন
২৪ জনের কাছ থেকে কয়েক কোটি টাকা নেয়
drafts.why_new: Adds to 'People he has already sent': a ten-year local track record, followed by a batch of 24 none of whom arrived.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: On 5 July 2024, when Rasel Mia came to his home in Jagannathpur, Bhairab, victims' families surrounded and beat him and handed him to police; the father of one victim then filed a case and Rasel was sent to Kishoreganj district jail under the trafficking Act, the officer-in-charge of Bhairab police station said.
quotes: ৫ জুলাই রাসেল নিজের বাড়ি
পরে পুলিশ তাঁকে ধরে নিয়ে
শফিকুলের বাবা এবাদুল্লাহ বাদী হয়ে
drafts.why_new: The case and arrest came only after the families themselves caught the broker.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: Rasel Mia admitted under police questioning that he took money on the promise of sending people to Italy, and said he had made all the arrangements but could not send everyone because new problems had arisen on the sea route, at which everyone grew impatient.
quotes: ইতালি পাঠানোর প্রতিশ্রুতিতে টাকা নেওয়ার কথা
সাগরপথে নতুন করে সমস্যা দেখা দেওয়ায় সবাইকে পাঠাতে পারছিলেন না
drafts.why_new: The broker's own explanation, on record.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Prothom Alo reported on 21 September 2024 that a broker ring sent 26 young men from 25 families in Goalnagar union, Nasirnagar, Brahmanbaria, and Ratani village, Austagram, Kishoreganj, to Libya on the promise of Italy, each paying BDT 11 lakh; nine came home after torture and harassment, some of the rest were captive and several were missing.
quotes: ২৫টি পরিবারের ২৬ যুবককে ইতালিতে পাঠানোর কথা বলে লিবিয়ায় পাঠায় দালাল চক্রটি
এ জন্য প্রত্যেকেই ১১ লাখ করে টাকা দিতে হয়েছে
তাঁদের মধ্যে ৯ যুবক
drafts.why_new: A village cluster case with the outcome counted: 9 of 26 back, none in Italy.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: Returnees from Nasirnagar, Brahmanbaria, said each of them gave the broker Farhad Mia BDT 4 lakh before leaving, that he took BDT 4.5 lakh more from each while holding them in a camp in Libya, and that after they were caught on the boat and jailed and he got them out, he took another BDT 2.5 lakh from each family for a second 'game' (the boat crossing).
quotes: লিবিয়া যাওয়ার আগে সবাই ফরহাদকে চার লাখ টাকা করে দিয়েছেন
এর মাধ্যমে ইতালি পাঠানোর কথা বলে সবার পরিবারের কাছ থেকে আবার আড়াই লাখ টাকা করে নেন ফরহাদ
drafts.why_new: The instalment structure of one deal: before departure, in the camp, and again for each new boat attempt.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: The Nasirnagar returnees said that two and a half to three months after the last payment the broker sold them, that they spent three months in jail, reached their families through a Pakistani man and a man from Bhairab, and could come home only after each paid a further BDT 1 lakh 20 thousand for the air ticket and other costs; they returned between 7 August and 14 September 2024 after release from Libyan jail.
quotes: আড়াই থেকে তিন মাস পর ফরহাদ তাঁদের বিক্রি করে দেন
প্রত্যেকে বিমানের টিকিটসহ খরচ বাবদ আরও ১ লাখ ২০ হাজার টাকা করে দিলে তাঁরা দেশে ফিরে আসতে পারেন
গত ৭ আগস্ট থেকে ১৪ সেপ্টেম্বরের মধ্যে লিবিয়ার কারাগার থেকে ছাড়া পেয়ে দেশে ফিরে আসেন তাঁরা
drafts.why_new: Getting out of Libyan jail and home cost each man a further BDT 1.2 lakh, paid by the family.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Suman Mia of Nasirnagar told Prothom Alo he paid the broker BDT 11 lakh in all and was told he would be taken to Italy within a week; he said 60 people were put on a boat from Benghazi, and after it had run for an hour they understood they had all been sold.
quotes: ইতালি যেতে ফরহাদকে সর্বমোট ১১ লাখ টাকা
পরে বেনগাজি শহর থেকে
drafts.why_new: A 'boat to Italy' that was in fact the handover to buyers.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Suman Mia said the 60 were held in a camp for a month and a half, beaten every day and fed once in 24 hours, given two litres of salt water for bathing and the toilet and one bread at night, and made to do cleaning work from morning to evening at the house of a man named Ahammad, whose son beat them with a pistol when they did not work.
quotes: একটি ক্যাম্পে নিয়ে তাঁদের রাখা হয় দেড় মাস
সকাল থেকে সন্ধ্যা পর্যন্ত আহাম্মদ নামের একজনের বাড়িতে তাঁরা পরিষ্কার-পরিচ্ছন্নতার কাজ করতেন। কাজ না করলে আহাম্মদের ছেলে পিস্তল দিয়ে মারধর করতেন ও হুমকি দিতেন
drafts.why_new: Conditions and forced unpaid labour in the camp, in a survivor's words.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Enamul Haque of Lalurtuk village, Nasirnagar, said he spent BDT 22 lakh to send two sons (land sold for BDT 7 lakh, a BDT 12 lakh loan and savings), that one son was 'sold four times', and that he last spoke to the other a year earlier; both were missing in September 2024.
quotes: সাত লাখ টেহার জমি বিক্রি করছি। ১২ লাখ টেহা ঋণ করছি। জমাইছিলাম কিছু টেহা। এমনে ২২ লাখ টেহা দিয়া দুই পুলারে বিদেশ পাঠাইছিলাম
তাকবিরুলরে চাইর বার বেচছে। তফসিরুলের লগে এক বছর আগে সর্বশেষ কথা অইছিল। অহন হেরা নিখুঁজ
drafts.why_new: Repeated resale of one person (four times), and disappearance for a year.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: The Nasirnagar Upazila Nirbahi Officer told Prothom Alo in September 2024 that the administration had not known of the 26 men's cases until journalists told them, that none of the victims had complained to it, and that legal action would follow an investigation if a complaint came; relatives had held a human chain demanding the brokers' trial and compensation.
quotes: ভুক্তভোগী ব্যক্তিদের কেউই তাঁদের কাছে কোনো অভিযোগ করেননি
দালালদের বিচার দাবি করে ক্ষতিপূরণ চেয়ে স্বজনেরা এলাকায় মানববন্ধনও করেছেন
drafts.why_new: What did not happen: no complaint, so no official action, 26 victims notwithstanding.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: One man the Nasirnagar families accuse, a cousin of the alleged ring leader, told Prothom Alo he had himself gone to Libya through that cousin, spent a month and a half in jail there with the others and 18 months in Libya in all, and took money from no one.
quotes: আমি চাচাতো ভাই ফরহাদের মাধ্যমে লিবিয়ায় গিয়েছি
আমি কারও কাছ থেকে টাকা নিইনি
drafts.why_new: The accused's denial; also shows a relative of the broker travelling in the same batch.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: Faridul Alam of Chandanaish, Chattogram, who had worked in Dubai since 2003, told a columnist writing in Prothom Alo in December 2024 that he made a verbal contract of BDT 5 lakh with a Bangladeshi broker from Noakhali to be taken as far as Greece: BDT 50,000 in advance, BDT 1.5 lakh after reaching Iran and the remaining BDT 3 lakh after reaching Turkey.
quotes: দালালের সঙ্গে মৌখিক চুক্তি হলো পাঁচ লাখ টাকায়
এরপর দেড় লাখ টাকা দিতে হবে
drafts.why_new: A stage-payment contract tied to borders crossed (advance, Iran, Turkey) on a route the guide does not cover.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: By Faridul Alam's account, at the end of 2010 the smugglers put him and several others in a taxi in Dubai that crossed the UAE border into a coastal hill area of Oman though the passengers had no passport or visa, and from there about thirty young men were put on a boat to Bandar Abbas in Iran, where another Bangladeshi broker received them.
quotes: যাত্রীদের কোনো ধরনের পাসপোর্ট-ভিসা না থাকলেও তাঁদের নিয়ে ট্যাক্সিটি আরব আমিরাতের সীমান্ত পার হয়ে ওমান পৌঁছাল
জনা তিরিশেক যুবককে একত্রে তুলে দেওয়া হলো একটি বোটে
বোট পৌঁছাল ইরানের বন্দর আব্বাসে, যাকে ফরিদ যাকে বলেছেন ‘বান্দ্রাবাস’। বন্দর আব্বাসে মাসুম নামের আরেক বাঙালি দালাল তাঁদের রিসিভ করলেন
drafts.why_new: First legs of the Gulf-to-Greece route: Dubai, Oman by taxi, boat to Bandar Abbas.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: By Faridul Alam's account, after he reached Iran a relative in Dubai deposited BDT 1.5 lakh into an Iranian bank account the brokers gave, and the balance of the contract was paid into a bank account the brokers gave while the group was held in Istanbul.
quotes: ইরানে পৌঁছানোর পর দালালদের দেওয়া ইরানি ব্যাংক অ্যাকাউন্টে
এখানে থাকতেই চুক্তির বাকি টাকা
drafts.why_new: How the stage payments are collected: bank accounts supplied by the brokers in the transit country.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: Faridul Alam said the group was kept about seven days in Iran and taken by taxi and then bus into Turkey, that police took them off the bus on the way to Istanbul and sent them back to the border six times, and that the broker's men sent them again each time until they reached Istanbul on the seventh attempt.
quotes: ইরানে সাত দিনের মতো তাঁদের রাখা হয় বেশ আদরযত্নে। এক সপ্তাহ পর তাঁদের ইরান থেকে প্রথমে ট্যাক্সিতে ও পরে বাসে নিয়ে যাওয়া হয় তুরস্কে
এভাবে ইস্তাম্বুল যাওয়ার পথে ছয়বার
drafts.why_new: Iran-Turkey leg, with six failed attempts inside Turkey.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: Faridul Alam said that in Istanbul many people were kept crammed in one room and not allowed outside for more than a month, and that about a hundred people were then loaded for Greece into a closed lorry-like vehicle with room for 25 to 30 at most.
quotes: এক রুমে গাদাগাদি করে
এই গাড়ির ধারণক্ষমতা বড়জোর ২৫-৩০ জন
drafts.why_new: Holding house in Istanbul and the overloaded closed lorry across the Greek border.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: By Faridul Alam's account, Greek soldiers or border guards caught the group where the lorry dropped them and put them in jail, UN refugee agency staff then moved them to a refugee camp, and after about ten days they were given a document called a 'stay paper' and took a bus to Athens with the EUR 60 per person the smugglers had handed them in Istanbul.
quotes: গ্রিসের সেনাবাহিনী বা সীমান্তরক্ষীরা
এই শরণার্থীশিবিরে দিন দশেক
পাচারকারীরা তাঁদের হাতে জনপ্রতি ৬০ ইউরো
drafts.why_new: What arrival in Greece looked like on this route.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: Faridul Alam said he presented himself as Rohingya in all his asylum applications in Greece because the smuggling ring's brokers advised that asylum might be easier that way; the court did not accept his application and stamped his stay paper, which let him stay one month, and he never got asylum in Greece despite four or five interviews.
quotes: সব অ্যাসাইলামের আবেদনে ফরিদ নিজেকে রোহিঙ্গা পরিচয় দিয়েছিলেন
এই পেপার তাঁকে এক মাস
চার-পাঁচবার ইন্টারভিউ দিয়েছেন
drafts.why_new: Brokers coaching a false nationality for asylum, and that it did not work.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: Faridul Alam said he lived about four years in Athens hawking and doing manual work, with police at times detaining him and taking his goods, and that what he earned fed him and left nothing to send to his family in Bangladesh.
quotes: হকারির জিনিসপত্র পুলিশের হাতিয়ে নেওয়া
নিজের পেট চালিয়ে
drafts.why_new: The economic outcome: no remittance after reaching Europe.

drafts.target_section: The Balkans and Eastern Europe > The path
drafts.claim: Faridul Alam said that at the end of 2014 he left Athens by bus with two or three other Bangladeshis for Macedonia, then Serbia, then Hungary, where the bus of Afghan, Pakistani and Bangladeshi refugees was taken to a refugee camp; he then left for Austria and Germany, and in the Czech Republic police held him eight to ten days and took the money and papers in his bag and pockets and did not return them.
quotes: বাসে রওনা হয়ে ফরিদ প্রথমে এলেন মেসিডোনিয়ায়
থানা হেফাজতে পুলিশ ফরিদের ব্যাগে-পকেটে
কিন্তু এই পুলিশ তাঁর কিছুই আর ফেরত দেয় না
drafts.why_new: The Greece-Macedonia-Serbia-Hungary overland leg, from a man who did it.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: Faridul Alam's asylum applications were rejected in Germany, where he lived on EUR 350 a month from a refugee camp from 2015 to 2018, and again in Paris, where the process took from 2018 to 2021; in December 2024 he was cooking for a mess of Bangladeshis in La Courneuve, Paris.
quotes: ক্যাম্প থেকে পাওয়া মাসিক ৩৫০ ইউরো
কিন্তু যথারীতি তাঁর আবেদন এখানেও নামঞ্জুর হয়
drafts.why_new: Fourteen years after leaving Dubai: three countries' asylum refusals and no legal status.

drafts.target_section: NEW: From the Gulf overland through Iran and Turkey to Greece
drafts.claim: Faridul Alam said the Bangladesh embassy in Paris took his application and fingerprints for a passport and, after a long wait, told him it could not issue a new passport unless he submitted his old Bangladeshi one, which he had thrown away when he set out from Dubai because, he said, an asylum application cannot be made while holding it.
quotes: দূতাবাস কর্তৃপক্ষ তাঁর আবেদন রাখল, তাঁর ফিঙ্গারপ্রিন্ট রাখল। তারপর অনেক দিন ঘুরিয়ে তাঁকে বলল, তাঁর পুরোনো বাংলাদেশি পাসপোর্ট জমা না দিতে পারলে তাঁরা তাঁকে কোনো নতুন পাসপোর্ট দিতে পারবে না
সেটি তো তাঁকে ফেলে দিতে হয়েছে
drafts.why_new: The cost of destroying the passport for an asylum claim: he cannot get a new one to go home.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: According to their families, three men from Noli Joynagar village, Mathbaria, Pirojpur, left for Libya through a broker in July 2023 on a contract of BDT 3 lakh and went first to Dubai, after which contact was lost; some time later they called on imo from Libya to report torture, and the ring demanded BDT 12 lakh ransom per person.
quotes: বাড়ি থেকে তাঁরা তিন লাখ টাকা চুক্তি করে
লিবিয়া থেকে ইমোতে ফোন করে
জনপ্রতি ১২ লাখ টাকা মুক্তিপণ দাবি করেছে
drafts.why_new: A BDT 3 lakh contract turned into a BDT 12 lakh ransom demand; the article does not say Italy was promised.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: The wife of one of the three Mathbaria men said in January 2025 she had sold 15 katha of land to raise the BDT 12 lakh ransom, and the father of another said he had paid BDT 15 lakh since his son left and did not know how much more he would have to pay.
quotes: সেই টাকা জোগাড় করতে ১৫ কাঠা জমি বিক্রি করেছেন
কিন্তু যাবার পর থেকে ১৫ লাখ টাকা দিছি, আর কত টাকা দিতে লাগব জানি না
drafts.why_new: Five times the contract already paid by one family, eighteen months on, with the men still held.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: The wife of one Mathbaria hostage refused to name the brokers to Prothom Alo in January 2025, saying she wanted her husband back, and the family of another refused to speak at all, believing someone known to the brokers lived near their home and that the torture would increase if word got out.
quotes: তাই আমি দালালের নাম বলতে পারব না
তাঁদের ধারণা, বাড়ির কাছেই
drafts.why_new: Why families stay silent while a relative is held: the ring has eyes in the village.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: The wife of one Mathbaria hostage filed a case under the trafficking Act at Mathbaria police station in 2024; the station's officer-in-charge said in January 2025 that the investigation had been given to the district detective branch and that it could say what progress there was.
quotes: ২০২৪ সালে লোকমানের স্ত্রী রিমা মঠবাড়িয়া থানায় মামলা করেন
জেলা গোয়েন্দা শাখায়
drafts.why_new: A case filed while the men were still hostages, with no reported result months later.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > Where to get help
drafts.claim: The Deputy Commissioner of Pirojpur, asked in January 2025 about three local men held for ransom in Libya, said the administration has little it can do in such cases, but that if the family complains it can inform the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in writing.
quotes: এ ধরনের ঘটনায় প্রশাসনের তেমন কিছু করণীয় থাকে না
drafts.why_new: What a district administration says it can actually do for a hostage's family: forward a written complaint to the Foreign Ministry.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: According to the Bangladesh embassy in Libya, a boat carrying 56 people trying to reach Italy from Libya sank in the Mediterranean on 25 January 2025 and 23 bodies washed up on the beach between 28 and 31 January; the bodies were decomposed and not formally identified, but the embassy, citing local sources, said nearly all were Bangladeshi.
quotes: ৫৬ জন আরোহী নিয়ে নৌযানটি গত ২৫ জানুয়ারি
স্থানীয় সূত্রের বরাতে
drafts.why_new: The January 2025 sinking (23 bodies) is not in the Death list.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > How it is sold
drafts.claim: The brother of Abul Bashar Akon (32) of Rajoir, Madaripur, who died with his nephew Titu Howlader (19) in the January 2025 sinking, said a BDT 14 lakh contract had been made a year and a half earlier with a broker from Mahendradi to send the two to Italy on an agricultural visa, and that when that broker could not deliver they were forced to decide on the Libya route and made a new contract through another broker.
quotes: দেড় বছর আগে ১৪ লাখ টাকা চুক্তিতে
পরে স্বপন অপারগ হলে
drafts.why_new: A named case of a paid-for legal visa (agricultural, Italy) failing and the family being moved onto the boat route.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > How it is sold
drafts.claim: The same brother said the broker had told the family the two men would reach Italy without any problem, that the family first heard of the nephew's death from the broker, and that the broker could no longer be found; the mother said both had told her by phone that they were fine and the broker would give them a 'game' very soon.
quotes: দালাল বলেছিল, কোনো সমস্যা ছাড়াই তারা ইতালি পৌঁছাবে
দালালকে এখন আর কোনোভাবেই খুঁজে পাচ্ছি না
দালালে নাকি ওগের খুব তারাতারি গেম দিব
drafts.why_new: The reassurance given before the boat and the broker's disappearance after it.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The path
drafts.claim: The boat crossing from Libya to Europe is known as the 'game'; small boats are mainly used and are loaded beyond capacity, Prothom Alo wrote in February 2025.
quotes: এ পথে ইউরোপে যাওয়ার জন্য মূলত
এই যাত্রা ‘গেম’ নামে পরিচিত
drafts.why_new: The guide uses 'game houses' without saying that the crossing itself is called the 'game'.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The path
drafts.claim: According to relatives, police and local sources, the two Rajoir men left home on 1 January 2025, flew from Dhaka through Dubai to Libya, were sent by the broker to the coast, and left the Libyan coast on an engine boat on 24 January.
quotes: ১ জানুয়ারি ইতালি যাওয়ার উদ্দেশে
২৪ জানুয়ারি লিবিয়ার উপকূল থেকে
drafts.why_new: Timing: 23 days from leaving home in Madaripur to the boat.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: According to police and local sources in Madaripur in February 2025, the ringleaders sending people from Rajoir to Italy through Libya take BDT 18 to 25 lakh from each person under a contract for Europe, and several times that amount must be paid if the person is caught by Libyan police or held by mafia there.
quotes: প্রত্যেকের কাছ থেকে ১৮ থেকে ২৫ লাখ
লিবিয়ার পুলিশের হাতে ধরা পড়লে
drafts.why_new: The 2025 Madaripur price range, with the police's own statement that capture multiplies it.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: After the January 2025 sinking, local brokers in Rajoir went into hiding for fear of arrest, Prothom Alo reported; Madaripur's Additional Superintendent of Police said police were investigating the broker ring, and the Additional Deputy Commissioner said the district administration had started work through the embassy to bring the bodies home.
quotes: পুলিশের গ্রেপ্তারের ভয়ে গা ঢাকা দিয়েছেন স্থানীয় দালালরা
এই দালাল চক্রের বিরুদ্ধে পুলিশ তদন্ত করছে
দূতাবাসের মাধ্যমে ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণে এরই মধ্যে কাজ শুরু করেছে জেলা প্রশাসন
drafts.why_new: What the authorities did in the first days: investigation announced, no arrest reported, repatriation of bodies through the district administration.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: Intelligence sources said in February 2025 that, besides the two dead, eight more people from Rajoir upazila, all aged 20 to 30, were reported missing, though it was not confirmed whether they were on the boat that sank on 25 January.
quotes: রাজৈর উপজেলায় আরও আটজন নিখোঁজ
drafts.why_new: Concentration in one upazila: ten dead or missing from Rajoir around one sinking.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: The father of Hridoy Howlader of Kamarkhali, Faridpur, said the group was to be taken to Italy by ship on the night of 24 January 2025, that many refused to board when a small boat was offered instead, and that those who refused were shot dead while those who boarded drowned, according to a Prothom Alo editorial of 6 February 2025.
quotes: ২৪ জানুয়ারি রাতে তাঁদের জাহাজে করে
যাঁরা উঠতে চাননি, তাঁদের গুলি করে হত্যা করেছে। যাঁরা উঠেছেন, তাঁরা ডুবে মারা গেছেন
drafts.why_new: A family's allegation that people who refused the small boat were shot; the guide has no account of forced boarding.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: Sujan Faraji of Madaripur, who died in the January 2025 sinking, set out with BDT 16 lakh taken from his aunt without telling his father, who had not agreed to the journey; a broker named Monir Sheikh of Majumdarkandi, Rajoir, had contracted to take him to Italy for BDT 15 lakh, according to a Prothom Alo editorial of 6 February 2025.
quotes: বাবা রাজি না হওয়ায়
মনির শেখ নামের এক দালাল সুজনের কাছ থেকে ১৫ লাখ টাকায় ইতালি নেওয়ার চুক্তি করেছিলেন
drafts.why_new: A young man leaving against his father's wishes on a relative's money; a BDT 15 lakh contract.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: Relatives said at least 12 people from Madaripur and Faridpur were among those who died in the January 2025 sinking off Libya, according to a Prothom Alo editorial of 6 February 2025.
quotes: লিবিয়ায় নিহত ব্যক্তিদের মধ্যে
drafts.why_new: District concentration of the dead in the January 2025 sinking.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: According to Bangladesh embassy sources in Tripoli cited in a Prothom Alo editorial of 6 February 2025, 4,200 Bangladeshis had been freed from various detention centres in Libya and sent home in the previous year and a half, and more than a thousand irregular Bangladeshis were still held in Libya.
quotes: গত দেড় বছরে লিবিয়ার বিভিন্ন বন্দিশালা থেকে
এখনো হাজারের বেশি অবৈধ বাংলাদেশি আটকে আছেন লিবিয়ায়
drafts.why_new: An embassy figure for returns from detention (mid-2023 to early 2025) and the number still held.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: A Prothom Alo editorial of 6 February 2025 stated that 84,000 Bangladeshis went to Europe by sea from 2009 to 2024 and that on average at least 100 Bangladeshis die each year when boats sink (it gives no source for either figure).
quotes: ২০০৯ থেকে ২০২৪ সাল পর্যন্ত ৮৪ হাজার বাংলাদেশি এভাবে সমুদ্রপথে ইউরোপে গেছেন
প্রতিবছর গড়ে অন্তত ১০০ বাংলাদেশি নৌকা ডুবে মারা যান
drafts.why_new: A Bangladeshi death estimate per year; the guide gives only all-nationality deaths. Unsourced in the article, so needs a source before use.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > How it is sold
drafts.claim: The migration analyst Asif Munir told Deutsche Welle that each person needs BDT 16 to 20 lakh for this journey and that international as well as local rings are involved, as quoted in a Prothom Alo editorial of 6 February 2025.
quotes: অভিবাসনবিষয়ক বিশ্লেষক আসিফ মুনির
drafts.why_new: A named analyst's price range in taka for early 2025.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: A Prothom Alo editorial of 6 February 2025 stated that some licensed manpower-exporting firms are behind these broker rings and send people abroad through them, and that cases against many such firms in the past led to no action because many of those involved were influential people linked to the then ruling party.
quotes: এই দালাল চক্রের পেছনে কিছু অনুমোদিত
অতীতে এ রকম অনেক প্রতিষ্ঠানের বিরুদ্ধে মামলা হলেও কোনো ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া হয়নি। কেননা এ চক্রের সঙ্গে জড়িতদের অনেকেই ছিলেন ক্ষমতাসীন রাজনৈতিক দলের সঙ্গে যুক্ত প্রভাবশালী
drafts.why_new: The newspaper's own assertion, not a sourced finding, that licensed agencies sit behind the boat brokers; flag as editorial opinion.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: According to relatives and police, 24 young men from Shariatpur and Madaripur who were taken from home in 2022 and 2023 to be sent to Italy from Libya by an illegal route went missing in Libya; relatives claim none of the 24 has contacted family since 21 and 22 March 2024.
quotes: ২৪ যুবক ও তরুণকে অবৈধ পথে
গত বছরের ২১ ও ২২ মার্চ থেকে ওই ২৪ জন পরিবারের সঙ্গে আর কোনো যোগাযোগ করছেন না বলে দাবি করেছেন স্বজনেরা
drafts.why_new: A batch of 24 from one broker lost on the same two days with no word for 11 months.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The path
drafts.claim: The 24 Shariatpur and Madaripur men were sent first to the United Arab Emirates, then through Egypt to Libya, according to Palong Model police station and relatives.
quotes: তাঁদের প্রথমে সংযুক্ত আরব আমিরাত
drafts.why_new: Confirms the UAE-Egypt-Libya routing for 2022-24 departures from Shariatpur.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: In the Shariatpur case the broker ring took BDT 12 lakh to 20 lakh from the families in various ways; several of the men were arrested twice by police in Libya and jailed and several were held hostage and tortured, and they were released from captivity and jail after money was collected from their families.
quotes: ১২ লাখ থেকে ২০ লাখ টাকা হাতিয়ে নিয়েছে দালাল চক্রটি
কয়েকজন লিবিয়ায় দুই দফায়
পরে পরিবারের সদস্যদের কাছ থেকে
drafts.why_new: Money taken both for release from hostage-takers and for release from Libyan jail.

drafts.target_section: Proof that is not proof
drafts.claim: The man arrested in the Shariatpur case, Rashed Khan of Charjadabpur village, Shariatpur Sadar, works at sending manpower to various countries and has a firm named Lamisa Enterprise, according to police and relatives; one wife said her husband left home with him on 3 February 2024.
quotes: রাশেদ খান বিভিন্ন দেশে জনশক্তি পাঠানোর কাজ করেন। লামিসা এন্টারপ্রাইজ নামে একটি প্রতিষ্ঠান আছে তাঁর
drafts.why_new: A broker with a named firm and a known manpower business in the district; the article gives no licence.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > How it is sold
drafts.claim: Fatema Akter of Shariatpur said her husband Shahin Sikdar (26) phoned some days after leaving home on 3 February 2024 to say they would be sent from Libya to Italy illegally by sea, that she last heard from him on the night of 22 March 2024, and that the broker took BDT 18 lakh from the family at various times; she said she could not stay in her area because of pressure from lenders.
quotes: কিছুদিন পরে তিনি (স্বামী) ফোন করে জানান, সমুদ্রপথে লিবিয়া থেকে অবৈধভাবে তাঁদের ইতালি পাঠানো হবে
দালাল রাশেদ বিভিন্ন সময়
ঋণের চাপে এলাকায় থাকতে পারছি না
drafts.why_new: The family learned the journey was the illegal sea route only by phone after he had left.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Riaz Akon said his family gave the broker BDT 20 lakh, raised by selling land and a cattle farm, to send his younger brother to Italy, had had no trace of him for a year, and that the broker gave no information when asked.
quotes: জমি ও গরুর খামার বিক্রি করে ছোট ভাইকে ইতালি পাঠানোর জন্য দালালকে ২০ লাখ টাকা দিই
রাশেদকে জিজ্ঞেস করলে সে কোনো তথ্য দেয় না
drafts.why_new: A second family's payment and the broker's silence.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: Relatives of the 24 missing men filed 11 cases against Rashed Khan and his associates in the Shariatpur court and at Palong Model police station; the CID arrested him in Jatrabari, Dhaka, on 14 February 2025 in a case under the trafficking Act filed by the father of a missing man from Kalkini, Madaripur, and a Shariatpur magistrate sent him to jail the next day, fixing a later date to hear the police's remand request and his bail application.
quotes: ১১টি মামলা করেছেন ভুক্তভোগী ব্যক্তিদের স্বজনেরা
শুক্রবার পুলিশের অপরাধ তদন্ত বিভাগ ঢাকার যাত্রাবাড়ী এলাকায় অভিযান চালিয়ে রাশেদ খানকে গ্রেপ্তার করে
গ্রেপ্তার আসামিকে জিজ্ঞাসাবাদের জন্য
drafts.why_new: Eleven cases by families led to a CID arrest in Dhaka; shows the route from family case to arrest.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > Where to get help
drafts.claim: On 15 February 2025, on hearing of the arrest, relatives of the missing men began a hunger strike in the grounds of the Shariatpur District and Sessions Judge's court demanding exemplary punishment and the tracing of the missing men.
quotes: দৃষ্টান্তমূলক শাস্তি দাবি ও নিখোঁজ ব্যক্তিদের সন্ধান চেয়ে শনিবার দুপুরে শরীয়তপুর জেলা ও দায়রা জজ আদালত চত্বরে অনশনে বসেন স্বজনেরা
drafts.why_new: Arrest did not produce information on the missing; families resorted to a hunger strike.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: BDT 15 lakh, then BDT 30 lakh more: according to his family, Md Rasel Mia (25) of Dharmandal village, Nasirnagar, Brahmanbaria, went to Libya in early 2024 through a broker from his own village for BDT 15 lakh, raised by selling the ancestral homestead and borrowing from relatives; he was sold to a local ring on arrival, which sent videos of his torture to Bangladesh and took a further BDT 30 lakh from the family in rounds.
quotes: মোট ১৫ লাখ টাকা দিয়ে
লিবিয়ায় পৌঁছানোর পর তাঁকে
ভিডিও বাংলাদেশে পাঠিয়ে
drafts.why_new: A further contract-versus-final-price case: BDT 15 lakh agreed, BDT 45-50 lakh paid, and the man died.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: According to Rasel Mia's family, the ring demanded BDT 10 lakh more a few days before his death, and when the family could not pay he was tortured and died in Libya on 21 February 2025; the family learned of the death the next day through an expatriate, and his father, who said he had paid BDT 50 lakh in stages by selling his homestead and farmland, alleged his son was killed with a poisonous injection.
quotes: সর্বশেষ কয়েক দিন আগে আরও ১০ লাখ টাকা দাবি করে চক্রটি; কিন্তু টাকা দিতে না পারায় দালাল চক্রের সদস্যরা তাঁকে নির্যাতন করা শুরু করেন
কয়েক ধাপে ৫০ লাখ টাকা দিছি
টাকা না দেওয়ায় বিষাক্ত ইনজেকশন দিয়ে
drafts.why_new: Death after the family ran out of money, having paid BDT 50 lakh; guide's Death list has boats only, plus the two contract-price cases.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: After Rasel Mia's death the broker from his village fled with his family, Prothom Alo reported on 22 February 2025; the officer-in-charge of Nasirnagar police station said legal steps would be taken if the victim's family gave a written complaint.
quotes: ঘটনার পর থেকে পরিবার নিয়ে তিনি পলাতক
লিখিত অভিযোগ পেলে
drafts.why_new: No case at the time of death: police wait for a written complaint while the broker absconds.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > How it is sold
drafts.claim: Khurshed Mia (35), a vegetable seller in Bhairab, Kishoreganj, said he first went to Libya on 14 June 2023 for BDT 4 lakh on the understanding that the broker would find him work in Libya until he went on to Italy, and that he got work there as a painter.
quotes: ২০২৩ সালের ১৪ জুন চার লাখ টাকা দিয়ে
কথা ছিল, ইতালিতে যাওয়ার আগপর্যন্ত
drafts.why_new: A named case of the 'work in Libya first' offer, with the entry price (BDT 4 lakh).

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Khurshed Mia said that in Libya he paid 500 dinars to get a job at a shopping mall that was to pay 1,400 dinars a month and was paid half, then worked four months at an oil company for 1,200 dinars a month.
quotes: ৫০০ দিনারের বিনিময়ে
প্রতি মাসে ১ হাজার ২০০ দিনার বেতনে সেখানে ছিলেন চার মাস
drafts.why_new: What work in Libya paid in 2024, the fee to get a job, and wage theft.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: Khurshed Mia said that while working in Libya he agreed with a broker to be taken by sea to Italy for BDT 9 lakh and paid BDT 6 lakh in two rounds without reaching Italy; he said the whole attempt cost him BDT 19 lakh, plus several lakh for treatment, and that he had to sell the land his house stood on.
quotes: ৯ লাখ টাকার বিনিময়ে
সব মিলিয়ে তাঁর ১৯ লাখ টাকা খরচ হয়েছে
drafts.why_new: The price of the sea leg alone when bought inside Libya (BDT 9 lakh) against the total spent (BDT 19 lakh).

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Khurshed Mia said law-enforcement officers raided the fourth-floor flat where 11 of them lived at about 1:30 am on 10 July 2024 and he hid for two hours on the window ledge; later he was kept in a place with 210 other people, where a raid at 10 pm took away 160 while he hid for four hours in a tree.
quotes: গত বছরের ১০ জুলাই রাত দেড়টার দিকে
সেখানে তাঁর সঙ্গে আরও ২১০ জনকে রাখা হয়
ওই দিনের অভিযানে ১৬০ জনকে
drafts.why_new: Raids by Libyan forces on migrants' housing and on a holding house of over 200 people.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Khurshed Mia said a mafia group attacked the building the broker had moved him to and he jumped from the first floor to save himself, injuring his arm and leg; he got no treatment for five days, the broker's men moved him from a private hospital to a government hospital because they could not bear the cost, he had five operations in three and a half months there, and he came home on 13 February 2025 unable to walk.
quotes: ওই ভবনে মাফিয়া চক্র হামলা চালায়
ব্যয়ভার বহন করতে না পেরে
এ সময়ে তাঁর পাঁচটি অস্ত্রোপচার হয়
drafts.why_new: Permanent disability as an outcome, and what medical care looked like for an injured migrant in Libya.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: A Prothom Alo editorial of 1 April 2026 said the family of Shayek Ahmed (23) of Sunamganj gave brokers BDT 12 lakh by selling their cows and land, that the rubber boat he left on from Libya for Greece on 21 March lost its way and drifted for six days, that he died of starvation when the food ran out, and that 12 young men from Sunamganj died on that journey and their bodies were thrown into the sea.
quotes: গরু, জমি বিক্রি করে ১২ লাখ টাকা
গত ২১ মার্চ রওনা দেওয়া রাবারের নৌকাটি
সুনামগঞ্জেরই ১২ তরুণের মৃত্যু হয়েছে
drafts.why_new: Adds to the March 2026 Greece boat already in the Death list: rubber boat, six days adrift, death by starvation, 12 of the dead from Sunamganj, price paid.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: According to CID information cited in a Prothom Alo editorial of 1 April 2026, 17,000 Bangladeshis were sent to Italy by illegal routes in the previous year.
quotes: গত এক বছরে অবৈধ পথে
drafts.why_new: A CID figure for the year to March 2026; differs from the 20,164 sea arrivals for 2025 the section already gives, so note the source.

drafts.target_section: The law in Bangladesh
drafts.claim: According to Home Ministry data cited in a Prothom Alo editorial of 1 April 2026, about 4,500 cases were filed under the trafficking Act in the five years 2020 to 2024, and 94 to 95 per cent of the accused in them were acquitted; the editorial added that in most incidents no case is filed at all.
quotes: বেশির ভাগ ক্ষেত্রেই মামলা হয় না
drafts.why_new: Five-year case count and acquittal rate under the old Act.

drafts.target_section: The Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013
drafts.claim: Speakers at a roundtable held by BRAC and Prothom Alo in Sylhet on 18 April 2026 said there is no legal way to go abroad by sea and that no one can lawfully leave Bangladesh for work abroad except through the Dhaka, Chattogram and Sylhet airports.
quotes: সমুদ্রপথে বৈধভাবে বিদেশে যাওয়ার কোনো সুযোগ নেই
দেশের ঢাকা, চট্টগ্রাম ও সিলেট বিমানবন্দর ছাড়া
drafts.why_new: States in plain words which exits are lawful; the guide cites section 34 ('official exit point') without naming them.

drafts.target_section: Student visas used as work routes > What happens
drafts.claim: Shahriar Zaman, who returned after ten years in the United Kingdom, told a roundtable in Sylhet on 18 April 2026 that he went there to study through brokers who said he could work legally alongside his studies, that he found nothing of the kind and had to work illegally, and that he was paid GBP 1 an hour where others got GBP 8.
quotes: প্রথমে দালালেরা পড়াশোনার পাশাপাশি
যেখানে অন্যরা ঘণ্টায় আট পাউন্ড
drafts.why_new: A returnee's wage figure for undocumented work after a broker-arranged student route to the UK.

drafts.target_section: Departure day at the airport > Who gets stopped
drafts.claim: Joni Lal Deb, Assistant Superintendent of Police with 7 APBn (Armed Police Battalion) at Sylhet's Osmani International Airport, said on 18 April 2026 that an active group of human traffickers and smugglers operates in the airport area and tries to mislead ordinary passengers with various inducements.
quotes: বিমানবন্দর–সংশ্লিষ্ট এলাকায় মানব পাচারকারী
drafts.why_new: A named airport police officer on touts working the airport area at Sylhet.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The contract price and the final price
drafts.claim: According to an account by Bangladesh's ambassador to Libya, Major General Habib Ullah, quoted by former foreign affairs adviser Md Touhid Hossain in Prothom Alo on 27 April 2026, among 113 irregular migrants sent home from Libya one had paid brokers and mafia BDT 82 lakh in stages and another BDT 73 lakh, and when asked how many had paid a broker more than BDT 20 lakh, over fifty of the 113 raised their hands.
quotes: একজন ধাপে ধাপে বিরাশি লাখ টাকা দিয়েছেন
কতজন বিশ লাখের ওপরে টাকা দিয়েছে দালালকে
drafts.why_new: The highest totals on record in these articles (BDT 82 and 73 lakh), and a share: nearly half of one return flight had paid over BDT 20 lakh.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: By the ambassador's account, about two-thirds of the 113 returnees on that flight identified themselves as from Madaripur.
quotes: জমায়েতের প্রায় দুই–তৃতীয়াংশ
drafts.why_new: How concentrated the route is in one district, from a head count on a return flight.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Returnees told the ambassador to Libya before their flight home in spring 2026 that one had eaten rice once after twenty days, five men sharing one bowl with no curry, that another got a handful after twenty-five days, and that a piece of bread was thrown at them 'the way food is given to a dog' and they were beaten as well.
quotes: বিশ দিন পরে ভাত খাইছি এক দিন; পাঁচজনে মিল্যা এক বাটি। তরকারি ছাড়া। ওই ভাই খাইছে পঁচিশ দিন পরে, এক মুঠ
ঢিল মাইরা খবজা দেয় একটা
drafts.why_new: Detainees' own words on food in captivity.

drafts.target_section: Recruited while abroad or just back
drafts.claim: One of the 113 returnees told the ambassador he had lived in Libya for 14 years before deciding, in old age, to try the 'game' (the boat crossing to Italy).
quotes: ১৪ বছর ধইরা আছি লিবিয়া
drafts.why_new: Long-settled workers in Libya also take the boat; the section has Gulf and Russia examples only.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > Where to get help
drafts.claim: The 113 migrants reached Dhaka the next day, and IOM paid the whole cost from the airfare to their travel back to their own villages, Md Touhid Hossain wrote in Prothom Alo on 27 April 2026; they went home with nothing.
quotes: তাঁদের বিমানভাড়া থেকে শুরু করে
একেবারে শূন্য হাতে পরিবারের কাছে ফিরে যান এই মানুষগুলো
drafts.why_new: Says exactly what IOM covers on a return flight: airfare and onward travel to the village.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: On 4 April 2026 a wooden boat that left Tajoura, Libya, for the Italian island of Lampedusa with about 105 passengers sank; 32 people were rescued alive and 2 bodies recovered, the other 71 were missing, and Bangladeshis were among both the rescued and the missing, Md Touhid Hossain wrote in Prothom Alo on 27 April 2026.
quotes: ৪ এপ্রিল লিবিয়ার তাজোরা থেকে
পরে সেখান থেকে ৩২ জনকে জীবিত এবং ২ জনের মৃতদেহ উদ্ধার করা হয়। বাকি ৭১ জন নিখোঁজ
drafts.why_new: The April 2026 Tajoura sinking is not in the Death list; names Tajoura as a departure point.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Md Touhid Hossain wrote in Prothom Alo on 27 April 2026 that a boat that left Libya for Greece on 21 March 2026 with 48 passengers drifted for six days before 26 people were rescued alive, 21 of them Bangladeshis, and that 20 of the 22 dead or missing were reported to be Bangladeshi.
quotes: গত ২১ মার্চ লিবিয়া থেকে ৪৮ জন যাত্রী
মৃত বা নিখোঁজ ২২ জনের মধ্যে ২০ জন বাংলাদেশি বলে জানা গেছে
drafts.why_new: Different counts from the guide's for the same March 2026 boat (guide: 43 aboard, 38 Bangladeshis, at least 18 dead); record the conflict.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The path
drafts.claim: Md Touhid Hossain, the former foreign affairs adviser, wrote in April 2026 that because surveillance and restrictions on the route to Italy had recently increased, traffickers were now using the Greece route.
quotes: সম্প্রতি ইতালির পথে নজরদারি ও কড়াকড়ি বাড়ায় মানব পাচারকারীরা এখন গ্রিস রুট ব্যবহার করছে
drafts.why_new: A named former official on the 2026 shift from Italy to Greece as the destination from Libya.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The path
drafts.claim: Md Touhid Hossain wrote that the main route to Italy by sea used to be a flight to Kenya, then overland to Libya, then the boat, and that a person boards the plane to Kenya on a false story of a safari or tourism; along the way people change hands several times like goods.
quotes: প্রথমে বিমানে কেনিয়া
সাফারি বা পর্যটনের ভুয়া কথা বলে
পণ্যের মতো কয়েক দফায় হাতবদল হন
drafts.why_new: A Kenya entry point and the cover story used at departure; the guide's path lists only Dubai, Egypt, India and Sri Lanka.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > What happens
drafts.claim: Md Touhid Hossain wrote that many Bengalis are among those who torture the hostages in Libya, and that the people who collect ransom from families in Bangladesh by showing torture videos live undisturbed in the same society.
quotes: তাদের মধ্যে অনেক বাঙালিও জড়িত
নির্যাতনের ভিডিও দেখিয়ে
drafts.why_new: A former foreign adviser stating that Bangladeshis do the torturing and the ransom collection is done at home.

drafts.target_section: The staged-payment trap, and no receipts
drafts.claim: The Minister for Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment, Ariful Haque Chowdhury, said at a roundtable in Sylhet on 18 April 2026 that the government is building a system to stop people being cheated by paying brokers, and plans, in discussion with the Bangladesh Bank governor, to introduce a 'Probashi card' so that migrants are served through a set system instead of cash transactions.
quotes: দালালদের টাকা দিয়ে প্রতারিত হওয়া থেকে বাঁচাতে
‘প্রবাসী কার্ড’ প্রবর্তনের পরিকল্পনা রয়েছে
drafts.why_new: A stated government plan (not yet a scheme) to replace cash payments; the guide has nothing on it.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The law
drafts.claim: The Minister for Expatriates' Welfare said on 18 April 2026 that the government had declared zero tolerance of the 'mafia syndicate' at home and abroad and was determined to identify the Bangladeshi members of trafficking rings in Libya and elsewhere, bring them back and try them.
quotes: লিবিয়াসহ বিশ্বের যেকোনো প্রান্তের
drafts.why_new: A ministerial commitment on Bangladeshi traffickers based in Libya; a statement of intent, not an action taken.

drafts.target_section: Libya to Italy by boat > The numbers
drafts.claim: Shariful Islam Hasan, associate director of BRAC's Migration Programme, said on 18 April 2026 that Bangladeshis have for a decade been the largest group crossing the Mediterranean to Europe, and that people from 8 to 10 districts, among them Madaripur, Shariatpur, Sylhet, Sunamganj and Habiganj, are losing their lives going this way; the news report of the same meeting also has him naming Kishoreganj.
quotes: মাদারীপুর, শরীয়তপুর, সিলেট, সুনামগঞ্জ, হবিগঞ্জসহ ৮-১০টি জেলার মানুষ এভাবে বিদেশ যেতে গিয়ে প্রাণ হারাচ্ছেন
সারা বিশ্বের মধ্যে বাংলাদেশের মানুষ সবচেয়ে বেশি
drafts.why_new: The source districts, named by BRAC; the guide gives no district list for the boat route.

drafts.target_section: Where victims and families get help
drafts.claim: Shariful Islam Hasan of BRAC's Migration Programme said on 18 April 2026 that the programme had helped about 39,000 people at the airport in the previous eight years, and gives returnees reintegration support and training, followed by counselling and help to set up as entrepreneurs.
quotes: গত আট বছরে বিমানবন্দরে প্রায় ৩৯ হাজার মানুষকে
পরবর্তী সময়ে তাদের কাউন্সেলিং
drafts.why_new: Scale of BRAC's airport help (39,000 in eight years) for the BRAC item in the help list.

drafts.target_section: Where victims and families get help
drafts.claim: Roksana Akter of Bishwanath, Sylhet, said on 18 April 2026 that she went to Saudi Arabia through a broker from Sunamganj, was abused in various ways at her workplace and had to borrow to come home, where she faced insult and neglect; she said the EU and BRAC's Prottasha-2 project then helped her set up a shop, whose income now runs her household.
quotes: সুনামগঞ্জের এক দালালের মাধ্যমে
একপর্যায়ে ঋণ করে দেশে ফিরে আসতে বাধ্য হই
প্রত্যাশা-২ প্রকল্প আমার পাশে এসে দাঁড়ায়। তাদের সহযোগিতায় আমি একটি দোকান করতে সক্ষম হই
drafts.why_new: Evidence from a returnee that BRAC's reintegration help (Prottasha-2) produced a working livelihood.

drafts.target_section: Departure day at the airport > Who gets stopped
drafts.claim: Joni Lal Deb, Assistant Superintendent of Police with 7 APBn at Osmani International Airport, Sylhet, said on 18 April 2026 that various rings use people going abroad for the first time as easy targets, especially to draw them into carrying drugs or smuggled goods, and that many do not realise they are becoming part of a crime ring.
quotes: প্রথমবার বিদেশে যাওয়া অনেক মানুষকে
অনেক সময় তাঁরা বুঝতেও পারেন না
drafts.why_new: A specific airport risk for first-time migrants (being used as carriers), stated by airport police.

drafts.target_section: Departure day at the airport > Who checks what
drafts.claim: The same officer said the armed police unit at Sylhet's Osmani airport should have more than three hundred members but has about one hundred, and that intelligence and plain-clothes members work the airport to stop anyone luring passengers.
quotes: এখানে তিন শ জনের বেশি সদস্য থাকার কথা থাকলেও আমরা আছি প্রায় এক শ জনের মতো
সাধারণ পোশাকে দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত সদস্যরা
drafts.why_new: Staffing at Sylhet airport security: a third of sanctioned strength.

drafts.target_section: The chain from the village to the visa seller
drafts.claim: Md Nazmus Sakib, assistant director of the District Employment and Manpower Office in Sylhet, said on 18 April 2026 that about 2,900 licensed agencies send workers abroad but all are Dhaka-centred, that only a few agencies work directly in Sylhet and the rest work as brokers under the cover of travel agencies, and that money beyond the set limit is being taken as a result.
quotes: প্রায় ২ হাজার ৯০০ লাইসেন্সধারী এজেন্সি
সিলেটে মাত্র কয়েকটি এজেন্সি সরাসরি কাজ করে
এতে নির্ধারিত সীমার বাইরে অতিরিক্ত অর্থ নেওয়ার ঘটনা ঘটছে
drafts.why_new: A DEMO official saying that outside Dhaka the 'agency' a migrant meets is usually a travel agency acting as broker.

drafts.target_section: The chain from the village to the visa seller
drafts.claim: Mohammad Nasir Uddin, general secretary of the Sylhet District Press Club, said on 18 April 2026 that Sylhet has over 150 licensed travel agencies but more than 500 agencies are in fact active illegally, taking BDT 8 lakh to 20 lakh to send people abroad (he gave no source for the figures).
quotes: সিলেটে দেড় শতাধিক ট্রাভেল এজেন্সি লাইসেন্সধারী হলেও বাস্তবে পাঁচ শতাধিক এজেন্সি অবৈধভাবে সক্রিয়, যারা ৮ থেকে ২০ লাখ টাকা পর্যন্ত নিয়ে মানুষকে বিদেশে পাঠাচ্ছে
drafts.why_new: A local estimate of unlicensed travel agencies in Sylhet and what they charge; unsourced, attribute to the speaker.

drafts.target_section: How do I register on OEP?
drafts.claim: The assistant director of Sylhet's District Employment and Manpower Office said on 18 April 2026 that the office gives people who want to go abroad through the government channel registration, fingerprinting and a three-day pre-decision training covering legal migration, avoiding brokers and safety, that many people fall in with brokers before the training, and that the office completed registration and biometrics for 35,290 people in 2025 and 6,290 up to March 2026.
quotes: নিবন্ধন, আঙুলের ছাপ ও তিন দিনের প্রাক্-সিদ্ধান্ত গ্রহণ প্রশিক্ষণ
বাস্তবে অনেকেই প্রশিক্ষণের আগেই দালাল চক্রে পড়ে
২০২৫ সালে আমরা ৩৫ হাজার ২৯০ জন এবং ২০২৬ সালের মার্চ পর্যন্ত ৬ হাজার ২৯০ জনের নিবন্ধন ও বায়োমেট্রিক সম্পন্ন করেছি
drafts.why_new: The three-day pre-decision training at the DEMO, and one district's registration volume.

drafts.target_section: The passport office
drafts.claim: Md Salah Uddin, deputy director of the Divisional Passport and Visa Office in Sylhet, said on 18 April 2026 that the regular-service passport fee is BDT 4,025 for five years and BDT 5,750 for ten years and the super-express fee is BDT 10,350, and that with super-express service a person who completes biometrics in the morning can get the passport in Dhaka by the afternoon.
quotes: সাধারণ সেবার ফি পাঁচ বছরের জন্য ৪ হাজার ২৫ টাকা, ১০ বছরের জন্য ৫ হাজার ৭৫০ টাকা; আর অতি জরুরি সেবার ফি ১০ হাজার ৩৫০ টাকা
অতি জরুরি সেবায় আজ সকালে
drafts.why_new: Ten-year fee and a super-express figure not in the guide (which gives 4,025 / 6,325 / 8,625); check the 10,350 figure against the official fee table.

drafts.target_section: The passport office
drafts.claim: The same passport official said a person aged 18 or over can apply with a national ID card and a person under 18 with a birth registration, paying the set fee at a bank and giving fingerprints.
quotes: জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র থাকলে এবং বয়স ১৮ বছর
drafts.why_new: Plain statement of the identity document needed by age, from a passport office head.

drafts.target_section: How do I join a TTC course?
drafts.claim: Zakir Hossain, senior instructor at the Sylhet government Technical Training Centre, said on 18 April 2026 that the centre runs regular Japanese, Italian, Korean and Arabic language courses and, with International Labour Organization support, level-three training in electrical installation and maintenance and in food preparation that combines language with the trade, with a possibility of work in Italy after the training.
quotes: জাপানি, ইতালীয়, কোরিয়ান ও আরবি ভাষার কোর্স
ইলেকট্রিক্যাল ইনস্টলেশন অ্যান্ড মেইনটেন্যান্স
প্রশিক্ষণ শেষে ইতালিতে কাজের সুযোগ তৈরির সম্ভাবনাও রয়েছে
drafts.why_new: A concrete legal alternative in a boat-route district: Italian-language and ILO-backed trade courses at Sylhet TTC.

drafts.target_section: How do I join a TTC course?
drafts.claim: The Sylhet TTC instructor said that many of the people who most need the training do not come, that college and university students with no immediate need to go abroad come instead, and that in the centre's experience about 99 per cent of people go abroad without acquiring any skill.
quotes: যাঁদের এই প্রশিক্ষণ সবচেয়ে বেশি প্রয়োজন
প্রায় ৯৯ শতাংশ মানুষ
drafts.why_new: A trainer's estimate that almost nobody who migrates from Sylhet has trained first.

drafts.target_section: What people pay, and to whom
drafts.claim: Mahbubul Mannan Chowdhury, acting regional head of Probashi Kallyan Bank (PKB, the state bank for migrants) in Sylhet, said on 18 April 2026 that by the ministry's list going abroad through the government channel costs about BDT 1 lakh 60 to 70 thousand, but that most people in practice spend more than BDT 4 to 5 lakh, and that agencies' profit reaching BDT 2.5 to 3 lakh cannot be justified.
quotes: সরকারি মাধ্যমে বিদেশে যেতে প্রায় ১ লাখ ৬০ থেকে ৭০ হাজার টাকা লাগে
অধিকাংশ মানুষ চার থেকে পাঁচ লাখ টাকার বেশি খরচ করে বিদেশ যাচ্ছেন
সেই লাভ যদি আড়াই থেকে তিন লাখ টাকা
drafts.why_new: A PKB regional head's figure for the gap between official cost and what borrowers actually pay, and his estimate of the agency margin.

drafts.target_section: Can I get a government loan to go abroad?
drafts.claim: The PKB acting regional head in Sylhet said on 18 April 2026 that many people come to the bank and have to take loans of BDT 3 to 4 lakh, with a monthly instalment of about BDT 14,000, and that many take four to five months or longer to get work after going abroad, during which the loan weighs on them more.
quotes: ৩ থেকে ৪ লাখ টাকার ঋণ নিতে বাধ্য হন
বিদেশে গিয়ে অনেকেরই কাজ পেতে
drafts.why_new: Typical PKB migration loan size and instalment, and the gap before the first wage, from the bank itself.

drafts.target_section: What help is there when I come back?
drafts.claim: The PKB acting regional head in Sylhet said on 18 April 2026 that the bank tries to help returnees who come back having suffered losses with loans at 8 per cent interest, but that in many cases this is not succeeding.
quotes: ৮ শতাংশ সুদের ঋণের মাধ্যমে কিছু সহায়তা দেওয়ার চেষ্টা করলেও অনেক ক্ষেত্রেই তা সফল হচ্ছে না
